speaker: Mary
text: Problem solved. Leonard, the Lord never gives us more than we can handle. Thankfully, he blessed me with two other children who are dumb as soup.

speaker: Mary
text: Excuse me, Dr. Gablehauser, are you busy? Sheldon, he's just doodling. Get in here.

speaker: Dr. Eric Gablehauser
text: Really? That's impressive. Well, actually.

speaker: Mary
text: Let's go, baby. We're losing daylight.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Dr. Gablehauser. Um, as you know, several weeks ago in our first encounter, we may have gotten off on the wrong foot when I called you an idiot. And I just wanted to say that I was wrong to point it out.

speaker: Dr. Eric Gablehauser
text: I'm sorry, we haven't been introduced. Dr. Eric Gablehauser.

speaker: Mary
text: Mary Cooper, Sheldon's mom.

speaker: Dr. Eric Gablehauser
text: Now, that's impossible. You must have had him when you were a teenager.

speaker: Mary
text: Oh, aren't you sweet? His father's dead.

speaker: Dr. Eric Gablehauser
text: Recently? Please. Sheldon, shouldn't you be working?

speaker: Mary
text: Long enough.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Okay.

speaker: Dr. Eric Gablehauser
text: Hey, how did it go?

speaker: Sheldon
text: I got my job back. I'm not quite sure. It involves a part of the human experience that has always eluded me.

speaker: Dr. Eric Gablehauser
text: What happened?

speaker: Dr. Eric Gablehauser
text: Well, that narrows it down.

speaker: Mary
text: I'm very proud of you, honey. You showed a lot of courage today.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Thanks, Mom. Mom. Is Dr. Gablehauser going to be my new daddy?

speaker: Mary
text: Mm-hmm.

speaker: Mary
text: We'll see. Sleep tight.
